h: The Joy Hidden Within Rebuke Exile and Complete Teshuvah

p: וְאִם לֹא תוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת יוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם
"But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you,
then it shall be that those whom you leave of them
shall be as thorns in your eyes
and as pricks in your sides," etc.;
"and it shall be that as I thought to do to them,
so I will do to you" (Bamidbar 33:55–56).
and of joy, "what does it accomplish?"
with the opening of the Pesikta
"Then it shall be that those whom you leave of them," etc.;
and it says that because Yisrael left over,
עַל יְדֵי זֶה נוֹלַד מִמֶּנָּה יִרְמְיָה
therefore Yirmiyahu was born from her,
and as pricks in their sides," etc.
"You shall not let any soul live,"
this is because they are the root
of the seven attributes of the opposite side.
also from the aspect of the seven nations of the opposite side
whose words of prophecy were always
about the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash,
that it would be given into the hand of the king of Bavel.
And this matter was to Yisrael
for they cast Yirmiyahu into the pit
because his prophecy was hard for them.
Now they said, of blessed memory,
"A prophet from your midst, from your brothers, like me," etc.,
who prophesied to Yisrael for forty years,
like the prophecy of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
and he also spoke words of rebuke
like Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him.
to the words of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
the Luchos would not have been broken,
and there would have been then, immediately,
the completion of the rectification in full.
as the pasuk says, "to him you shall listen,"
there would have been no exile in Yisrael.
a cause brought about by the One "awesome in His deeds,"
that Yisrael would not listen to him,
Yisrael would be refined and purified in exile;
in these times of Bein HaMetzarim,
the beginning of Yirmiyahu's words in his book,
they will act upon our hearts little by little,
And so the expression here fits:
we will merit to return to the good

p: The matter of "ve'hayah, as I thought"
יוּבַן עִם מַאֲמַר הַגְּמָרָא (בְּרָכוֹת לד, ב)
will be understood with the statement of the Gemara (Berachos 34b):
that all the prophets prophesied only
עַיִן לֹא רָאָתָה אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתֶיךָ (יְשַׁעְיָה סד, ג)
"no eye has seen it, God, except You" (Yeshayahu 64:3);
"In the place where baalei teshuvah stand,
and certainly both these and those
are the words of the Living God.
that certainly from the very beginning of Creation
the intent included the wicked as well,
כְּאָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא טז, א)
as they said, of blessed memory (Bava Basra 16a):
"You created tzaddikim, You created wicked men;
You created Gan Eden, You created Gehinnom."
and they cool the fire of Gehinnom
As we heard from someone who said,
הַלְוַאי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה הוּא בָּא לִידֵי זֶה
"Would that I might come to this,
that the Name of Heaven be sanctified through me
when I come to the truth
and say, 'You have judged well,'" etc.
וּכְדְאִיתָא בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ב, ה)
And as it says in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 2:5):
"'And the earth was formless and void'
these are the deeds of the wicked;
'And God said, Let there be light'
these are the deeds of the tzaddikim;
in which of them He desires," etc.
For in truth there was a deep intention
However, in the order of Creation it was
and the wicked would be among the nations of the world;
and from them too there would be praise
when they come to the truth
and are rectified in the end,
even though their power in their teshuvah is not so great
that their sins become like merits,
many blemishes and corruptions in Yisrael
and there were found in Yisrael themselves
those who are called by the name "wicked"
from them too the praise will rise,
וּבָזֶה יוּבְנוּ דִּבְרֵי הַמַּאן דְּאָמַר בַּגְּמָרָא
With this the words of the opinion in the Gemara will be understood,
that all the prophets prophesied only
how it was in the order of Creation;
and about this the prophets' perception was
from among the wicked of the nations of the world;
that is, if all Yisrael had been
according to the order of Creation
עַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר עַיִן לֹא רָאָתָה
about that it says, "no eye has seen it,"
שֶׁעַל זֶה אֵין הַשָּׂגַת שׁוּם נִבְרָא
for in this there is no created being whose perception
that in the place where baalei teshuvah stand
זֶה מוּסָב עַל כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוּא עַתָּה
this refers to how it is now,
only that baalei teshuvah from Yisrael
we can find an allusion in the pasuk:
"And it shall be that as I thought to do to them";
that is, as was the original thought
to do for the wicked among the nations,
that is, that now there will be needed
the rectification for the wicked within Yisrael;
only that with them it will be all the greater,
for after they return in complete teshuvah,
all their willful sins will be
that here too the word ve'hayah
that there will be complete joy
when we merit the general rectification,
and all the blemishes will be rectified,
so that they are reckoned as merits;
and there will be the complete Geulah,
